description: This Java interface defines methods for reading interest pause data related to loans in the Fineract platform. It includes methods to retrieve interest pause periods either by internal loan ID or external loan ID, returning lists of InterestPauseResponseDto objects.

classes.name: InterestPauseReadPlatformService
classes.description: Interface for retrieving interest pause details for loans, providing methods to get interest pauses by loan ID or external ID.

methods.name: retrieveInterestPauses
methods.description: Retrieves all interest pause periods for a specific loan given its internal ID.

methods.name: retrieveInterestPauses
methods.description: Retrieves all interest pause periods for a specific loan using its external ID.
